name: Commands Mental Powers
description: You possess potent psychic abilities, allowing you to manipulate minds and matter.
connectionOptions: One PC is immune to your mental powers.
You once accidentally read one PC's mind, learning a secret.
One PC helped you learn to control your abilities.
additionalEquipment: A headband or other object you use to focus your powers

abilities.name: Telepathic
abilities.description: You can speak telepathically with any creature you can see within short range.

abilities.name: Mind Reading
abilities.description: You can read the surface thoughts of a creature within short range.

abilities.name: Psychic Suggestion
abilities.description: You can attempt to implant a psychic suggestion in the mind of a creature within short range.

abilities.name: Mind Control
abilities.description: You can attempt to control the actions of a creature within short range for one round.

abilities.name: Telekinesis
abilities.description: You can move objects weighing up to 200 pounds with your mind.

abilities.name: Psychic Attack
abilities.description: You can launch a mental assault on a creature within long range, inflicting 5 points of Intellect damage.

abilities.name: Mind Palace
abilities.description: You can create a psychic construct that can hold up to three minds, allowing instant communication and shared perceptions.
